sql: SELECT d.date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '65' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'Cty-BaoYen' GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the daily total passenger count (y) for route 65 operated by Cty-BaoYen (d.route_id = '65' and TRIM(d.operator) = 'Cty-BaoYen') over the specified time period (d.date AS ds).
